title: Hermes3D LLM Planner Policy
description: Validated at supervisor boot per ADR-011. Phase 3.3 only — refusal at validation failure.

default_mode.description: Planner mode used when caller does not pass mode= explicitly. Phase 3.3 default MUST be 'template'.

provider_allowlist.description: Closed set of allowed LLM provider host identifiers. Hosts not present here are refused at gateway entry (ADR-011 §1).

cost_cap_usd_per_run.description: Hard cap on USD spent per orchestration run. R7 fires when an llm.complete call would exceed this cap.

cost_cap_usd_per_day.description: Hard cap on USD spent per UTC day across all runs. R7 fires when an llm.complete call would exceed this cap. MUST be >= cost_cap_usd_per_run.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-call timeout for the LLM gateway. Hard upper bound; Phase 3.3 default is 30 seconds.

prompt_max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte length of a sanitized prompt. Sanitizer rejects oversize with Err::PromptTooLarge.

retry_max.description: Number of transport-class retries the gateway may perform per call. Phase 3.3 default is 1; values >2 require a new ADR.

rate_per_second.description: Maximum gateway calls per second per token. Phase 3.3 default is 1.

input_usd_per_token.description: Cost coefficient applied to provider-reported input tokens for budget accounting.

output_usd_per_token.description: Cost coefficient applied to provider-reported output tokens for budget accounting.

max_completion_tokens.description: Worst-case completion size used in pre-call cost estimate (used to enforce R7 before the request leaves the gateway).

fallback_mode.description: Mode used when the LLM path fails any check. Phase 3.3 fallback MUST be 'template' (ADR-011 §5).
